intents.name: Universal Media Compatibility & Zero Monolithic Player / Database Wrappers
intents.description: Comprehensive container demuxing (MKV/WebM, MP4/MOV, AVI, MPEG-TS, FLV, OGG) and video/audio bitstream decoding (H.264, H.265, VP8, VP9, AV1; AAC, MP3, Opus, Vorbis, FLAC, PCM) while strictly prohibiting monolithic player IPC wrappers (mpv, vlc) and external database engines (sqlite, diesel, rocksdb).
invariants: Universal media compatibility across standard modern containers (MKV, MP4, WebM, AVI, TS, FLV) and codecs (H.264, H.265, VP8, VP9, AV1, AAC, MP3, Opus, FLAC)
Zero monolithic player script/IPC wrappers (mpv, mpv-sys, libmpv, vlc, libvlc)
Zero external database engines (sqlite, rusqlite, sqlx, sled, rocksdb, heed, tantivy, meilisearch, diesel)
Dual-temporal smart chat persists via custom crash-resilient binary log (syncplay_chat.bin) and in-memory inverted index FTS

intents.name: Deterministic High-RTT Network Clock Synchronization
intents.description: Clock phase alignment across transatlantic/transpacific WAN links (250-400ms RTT, +-30ms jitter) using RFC 5905 NTP 4-timestamp exchange, sliding-window min-RTT filtering with dispersion freezing defense, and discrete PI PLL micro-speed steering.
invariants: Effective dispersion floor D_effective >= 5.0ms preventing zero-dispersion freeze
Watchdog timer flushes buffer upon 8 consecutive rejections to recover from route shifts
Tri-zone drift policy: Zone 1 deadband (|e| < 15ms) holding r=1.0x, Zone 2 micro-speed (15ms <= |e| <= 1500ms) with r in [0.96, 1.04], Zone 3 hard seek (|e| > 1500ms)
Critically damped dynamics: e(0)=+450ms enters < 15ms deadband within <= 20s with 0 overshoot past -15ms

intents.name: Barrier-Synchronized Two-Phase Commit Unpause
intents.description: Scheduled playback resumption after seek or pause guaranteeing positive arrival margins across all peers and cross-peer start alignment under 10ms.
invariants: Target schedule: T_target_server = t_server_now + 1.5 * max(RTT) + t_preroll_budget + 100ms
Commit arrival safety margin >= 100ms across all pre-roll intervals
Cross-peer playback start time delta < 10ms

intents.name: Crash-Resilient Dual-Temporal Local Smart Chat
intents.description: Local append-only binary log (syncplay_chat.bin) with 0xAA55 framing, dual timestamps (t_wall, t_media), IEEE 802.3 CRC32 checksums, byte-by-byte false-sync recovery, in-memory inverted index FTS (CJK unigram/bigram segmentation with single ideograph exemption), and media slash commands (/seek, /bookmark, /clip, /poll, /sync-status).
invariants: Record total length = body_len + 10 (>= 48 bytes)
Forward scanner recovers from embedded 0xAA55 false-sync patterns without truncating valid trailing records
Authoritative truncation applied only to incomplete trailing writes at EOF
Unicode case folding (including Turkish dotted I) and CJK unigram + overlapping bigram indexing
Single ideograph indexing for CJK (1..48 chars)
Media slash commands parsed and normalized to integer milliseconds

intents.name: Desktop Graphical UI Architecture & Decoupled Lock-Free Responsiveness
intents.description: Native cross-platform desktop window (Wayland/X11 and Windows via eframe/egui with GPU texture viewport), aspect ratio preservation (letterbox/pillarbox), 128-byte cache-line aligned SPSC ring buffer eliminating false sharing, triple-buffered atomic UI snapshots (PlayerUiSnapshot, 72 bytes) published via Telemetry Aggregator, 10Hz scrubber debouncer, and <=15MB UI memory footprint.
invariants: Native desktop graphical window with Wayland/X11 and Windows support, GPU video surface, bottom playback controls, and watch-party sidebar
Video viewport aspect ratio preservation math guaranteeing deterministic letterboxing and pillarboxing without image distortion
SPSC head and tail pointers aligned to 128 bytes (#[repr(align(128))])
PlayerUiSnapshot fits in single 128-byte cache line pair (72 bytes <= 128 bytes)
Centralized Telemetry Aggregator topology guarantees zero torn reads for UI thread
10Hz scrubber debouncer: 500ms drag at 120Hz yields exactly 5 intermediate seeks + 1 final release seek = 6 commands
Single-channel Alpha8 font atlas (4MB) and bounded overlay (max 5 bubbles) conform to <= 15MB UI RAM budget

intents.name: Zero-Allocation Fixed-Point Color Transformation
intents.description: Pure-Rust Q8 fixed-point integer color space conversion (YUV420p to RGBA) for ITU-R BT.601 and BT.709 limited range with branchless clamping and zero heap allocations in hot loop.
invariants: Planar YUV420p row strides aligned to 16 bytes ((width + 15) & !15)
Plane allocations aligned to 64 bytes with +16B SIMD tail padding
Q8 fixed-point integer conversion matches reference primaries within +/-1 LSB
Zero heap allocations inside the per-frame transform loop

intents.name: Robust Container Demuxing & Timescale Integer Arithmetic
intents.description: RFC 8794 EBML VINT decoder and ISOBMFF 32/64-bit box parser rejecting malformed sizes, with 64-bit integer PTS timescale conversion avoiding overflow across 24h playback.
invariants: EBML VINT octet widths 1-8 decoded via leading_zeros() + 1
Matroska SimpleBlock PTS arithmetic computed with 64-bit integer arithmetic without overflow
ISOBMFF box parser validates 16 <= largesize <= i64::MAX and rejects invalid box headers
In-tree synthetic 48-byte EBML and 132-byte MP4 test vectors parsed with zero errors

intents.name: OpenSpec Traceability & Anti-Drift Guarantee
intents.description: Every capability requirement in openspec/specs/ and every change proposal in openspec/changes/ is mapped to executable Rust and empirical tests. No agent may self-certify without passing the Intent Harness.
